criteria.evidence: The saved raw OSM way 301841253 has address 607 and a 20-node closed ring. The official AGR Delta chapter site lists 607 N University; Purdue Agriculture identifies the chapter and shows its house. The builder source script constructs the principal shell directly from the saved ring.
criteria.finding: Identity and shell trace are well cross-checked. The footprint is community mapped and not an official survey.

criteria.evidence: Fresh master has one identity-rotation, unit-scale collection-instance marker at [-280.37158203125, 346.0006408691406]; it references the correct linked asset and is not also linked directly under the scene root. The reconstructed current world bounds differ from the pre-localization fresh-open bounds by at most 0.0450 m, preserving the prior campus placement through the local-coordinate conversion. The OSM polygon is 25.036 x 36.821 m, with a north-south long axis.
criteria.finding: Preservation through integration is verified, but the source coordinate transform is approximate and there is no independent Purdue survey control confirming the absolute campus registration.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: KJG Architecture identifies the Purdue AGR project as four levels and its project imagery supports a pitched dark roof, dormers, and brick/portico form; Purdue Agriculture house imagery corroborates the facade. The model represents four levels and pitched roof/dormers.
criteria.finding: Wall top, roof ridge, story spacing, and basement relationship remain estimates; no measured elevations or dimensioned plans were found.

criteria.evidence: Reviewed saved facade and oblique renders; they show warm red brick, repeated sash windows/shutters, pale belt courses, white columned portico, blue-gray fascia, arched entry glazing, and green AGR lettering, consistent with the saved Purdue Agriculture and KJG references. The source collection includes interior geometry, supported by the saved first-floor interior render.
criteria.finding: The model communicates the chapter-house identity, but roof and portico proportions are stylized; bay spacing and exact elevations are not source measured. The interior plan is illustrative.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh-open master inspection passes: the detailed local-coordinate asset is linked from the manifest path, marker points to its expected collection exactly once, the collection is not a direct scene-root child, marker transform is identity, and manifest/source object counts agree (727). Prior fresh-open asset validation found no external file images; the current library retains its source path, scene, collection, evidence, renders, and evaluator records.
criteria.finding: Master link and local placement are correct. Some textures and all interior room dimensions are schematic/illustrative rather than measured.

source_footprint.transform: PurdueMap approximate local conversion, X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; units metres
source_footprint.measurement_method: ordered closed OSM way ring converted to local XY; planar shoelace area and axis-aligned bounds
source_footprint.uncertainty: OSM outline is community-mapped and last edited 2022-02-27; local conversion is approximate, not survey control; campus master has no verified wall survey.

findings: Localization and master integration preserve the previously graded campus-world geometry within 0.10 m; computed difference is 0.0450 m.
One Placement_massing_house_301841253_f0b3be3 marker references the expected Asset_massing_house_301841253_f0b3be3 collection, and no direct root link duplicates it.
Manifest now records the local-coordinate detailed asset and matching source object count.
Absolute site registration relies on a 2022 community-mapped OSM footprint and an approximate local projection; Purdue survey confirmation is absent.
Roof heights, exact floor heights, basement relationship, and interior layout remain estimated or illustrative.
